tw-wi-wisconsin-mouth-coins-1887.t: Best guess for 'the point' is Ketchum's Point, the rise by the foot of Mac St, where the old portage trail met the river (Turner 1904; Mac St is on the 1878 map). 'Left bank' may instead mean the south side.
src: A. J. Turner, The Family Tree of Columbia County (1904), portage-trail note (PC (a))
